dialogue.htmlContent: You find yourself walking down yet another of Elis's narrow passages, lined by the usual series of inset doorways, discarded trash, and questionable stains. This time, however, as you're turning a corner, you notice two strangers ahead acting suspiciously though they don't appear to have noticed you yet. One figure, draped in a trenchcoat and fedora, is lurking in the dark and from what you can tell seems to be waiting impatiently while the wolf-boy before them fidgets nervously.
